raw.query: SELECT window_name, experiment, pool, policy, quantile, forecast_model, denominator_kind, numerator_worker_seconds/3600.0 AS num_gpu_h, denominator_worker_seconds/3600.0 AS den_gpu_h, cost_ratio, is_current FROM provenance.v_cost_ratio WHERE window_name='aggregate' AND quantile='p90' AND policy='forecast' ORDER BY is_current DESC, num_gpu_h
raw.observed: No p90-forecast row yields 0.965x. Aggregate p90-forecast v. deployable_static_c8 spans 0.34-0.88 (max 0.8825, chronos), all is_current=false (superseded). No 'TP2x2'/4-GPU static denominator exists; the only static baseline is 8-GPU C=8 = 1074.8 GPU-h, and there is no current p90-forecast aggregate row at all.
raw.claimed: 0.965x the GPU-hours of the burst-sized static TP2x2 fleet (518.6 vs 537.4 H100 GPU-h)
raw.evidence: Claim's 537.4 GPU-h = 4-GPU TP2x2 static is half the DB's comparable 8-GPU static baseline (1074.8 GPU-h); against that real baseline the p90-forecast ratio is ~0.48-0.88, never 0.965, and the only matching rows are superseded.
raw.fix: Benchmark against the operationally-honest 8-GPU static fleet (deployable_static_c8 = 1074.8 GPU-h) using a current p90-forecast run; the 0.965x figure only arises from a non-comparable half-size (4-GPU) denominator.
